svg.text: 43 domain entities / 111 domain attribute declarations / 3 submodels
All domain entities inherit directly or indirectly from BaseEntity (id, type, name, description, source). Common attributes are omitted.
Types follow Python property annotations; optionality, methods and visibility are omitted. Only domain inheritance is shown in this view.
Domain attribute declarations are counted once, at their defining class. Associations and multiplicities are reserved for the complete view.
